blocks.text: Affiliate and referral programs for SaaS with Stripe integration

Rewardful makes launching affiliate and referral programs straightforward for SaaS companies. The native Stripe integration means tracking subscriptions, commissions, and payouts happens automatically - no custom development or manual spreadsheet tracking required.

For SaaS companies, affiliate programs are often the highest-ROI growth channel. You only pay for results (successful conversions), affiliates handle the marketing work, and the customer acquisition cost is predictable. Rewardful makes this channel accessible without building custom tracking infrastructure.

The referral program option turns your existing customers into advocates. Offer discounts, credits, or cash rewards for successful referrals, and Rewardful handles the tracking, attribution, and reward fulfillment. Word-of-mouth becomes a structured, measurable growth channel.
Automatic subscription tracking and commission calculation
Self-service dashboard for affiliates to track performance
Percentage or flat-rate commissions with custom rules
Customer referral tracking with reward fulfillment
Automated commission payouts via PayPal or Wise
Automatic detection of self-referrals and suspicious activity

Affiliate and referral programs are the most efficient growth channels for SaaS companies. Rewardful makes launching them quick and keeps the ongoing management simple - you pay for results, not effort.
Our team can integrate Rewardful into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
